summary: Both retained source-bank failures are repaired. All eight checks pass; no new defect demonstrated. Package unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Apply stated elementary row operations to an augmented matrix and select the resulting matrix.
reasoning_steps: Identify the operation, row roles and scalar.
Update every affected entry, including the constants column.
Use updated intermediate rows for sequential operations.
invariants: Preserve augmented-column semantics and unaffected rows.
Use nonzero scaling and distinct addition source/target rows.
Provide one correct radio choice among five.
permitted_variations: Vary entries, eligible row roles, scalar signs and magnitudes.
Vary choice positions and matrix names.

source_replay.details: All 13 source cases replay, including 12 complete captured banks. Both retained regressions fail on preserved old code and pass current code. Missing source evidence is explicitly documented.

math.details: Independent exact arithmetic verifies unique correct answers and final solutions for 99 records, including the exact batch and controlled variants.

variety.details: All 48 independent easy samples and five batch records survive filtering. Samples cover all swap pairs and scaling targets. Learner selection was examined conditionally; live history and policy weights were unavailable.

scope.details: The revision adds guarded source replay banks. Sampling rules, supported operations, response contract and difficulty-specific workloads remain unchanged.

grading.details: Native grading accepts 35 correct selections and rejects 140 wrong selections, including controlled variants and normalized batch records. Free-entry notation is inapplicable.

rendering.details: The actual UI renders 24 source/control/batch records and five normalized batch records successfully. Seven representative screenshots were inspected.

packaging.details: Python 3.13.5 matches the dependency declaration. Determinism and relocation pass, including both new profiles. Recursive package hashes are unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Relevant changes alter computed and graded answers; renaming preserves them. Conditional position and magnitude probes demonstrate no incidental shortcut in the tested samples or surviving batch. The batch's two swaps share one row pair, limiting coverage claims.
